story_type: litter hoist from a dive boat in whitecaps far offshore, hoist camera
hook: 115 miles out, a litter swinging down to a rolling dive boat.
narration: A hundred and fifteen miles out at sea, this litter swung down toward a rolling dive boat.
A fifty-seven-year-old man had come up from a free dive with a snorkel, and his breathing was labored.
A paramedic on board gave him oxygen while they waited for help.
A Jayhawk crew from Coast Guard Sector San Diego flew out over open ocean to reach them.
A rescue litter keeps a patient lying flat and strapped in, so he can be lifted without having to hold on.
The flight mechanic worked the cable while the boat pushed on through the whitecaps.
[short pause] Then the litter came up off the deck and swung in toward the door.
outcome: The Jayhawk crew hoisted the diver aboard and medically evacuated him, a hundred and fifteen miles from San Diego.
title: Litter hoist 115 miles off San Diego
description:
On Sept. 7, 2016, a Coast Guard Sector San Diego MH-60 Jayhawk crew medically evacuated a 57-year-old man with labored breathing after a free dive, 115 miles west of San Diego.
